data.question_intent: Discuss the benefits of bond redemptions and the sustainability of distributions for Barclays Bank plc.
data.question_quote: Got two questions. One on these bonds that got redeemed in June. I think they were issued out of Barclays Bank plc, but is there any benefit to the UK bank? Because if there is, again the margin guidance for the second half looks slightly odd, but maybe you could tell us where the benefits of those bond redemptions sit, because they're obviously at some pretty big coupons? Where are the benefits of that coming across the divisions.
data.answer_quote: The bond redemptions that you're referring to, they're Barclays Bank so that's where most of the impact will be, so I think that's the gist of your question. Spreads are pretty tight and the timing of the redemptions is obviously helpful for us as a tailwind going into next year and beyond.
data.reason: The answer directly addresses the benefits of bond redemptions and the sustainability of distributions, providing a clear stance and high evidence level with numeric references.
